product.title: Glacier National Park Going-to-the-Sun Road Self-Guided Tour

description.text: Drive the iconic Going-to-the-Sun Road at your own pace with a Shaka Guide audio tour that shares park history, wildlife stories, and geology at GPS-triggered stops from Lake McDonald to Logan Pass. Download the tour to your phone and explore Glacier's alpine scenery without a fixed group schedule.

highlights: Self-guided audio tour along Going-to-the-Sun Road
GPS-triggered narration at Logan Pass and alpine pullouts
Flexible pacing with offline app access after download
Park history, wildlife, and geology commentary
Ideal complement to a full-day Sun Road drive

start.description: Download the Shaka Guide app and purchase tour access before entering Glacier National Park. Begin at the West Glacier or St. Mary entrance depending on your route.

end.description: Complete the Sun Road loop at your chosen endpoint—St. Mary or West Glacier—when you finish the audio route.

product.itinerarySummary: Drive the iconic Going-to-the-Sun Road at your own pace with a Shaka Guide audio tour that shares park history, wildlife stories, and geology at GPS-triggered stops from Lake McDonald to Logan Pass.

itineraryItems.title: Going-to-the-Sun Road
itineraryItems.description: Follow the full Going-to-the-Sun Road with audio commentary at major pullouts and viewpoints.

itineraryItems.title: Logan Pass
itineraryItems.description: Stop at Logan Pass for high-alpine views and optional short walks near the Continental Divide.

itineraryItems.title: Lake McDonald
itineraryItems.description: Begin or end at Lake McDonald with lakeshore views of the Lewis Range.

itineraryItems.title: Glacier National Park
itineraryItems.description: Audio narration covers park formation, wildlife, and road engineering history throughout the drive.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Glacier National Park Going-to-the-Sun Road Self-Guided Tour?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 10 to 11 hours.
